name: Classic 60/40
notes: Trades from 2021 (~5 years). The textbook balanced book: 60% US equities via SPY and 40% aggregate bonds via AGG, rebalanced monthly at 10bp. Linked to the official core-equity sleeve and the official defensive sleeve.
objective: Replicate a classic 60/40 strategic allocation with a small active equity overlay.
constraints: Long-only; 60% equity/40% bonds target; monthly rebalance; 10bp one-way cost.
